nodes.label: Feature Register
nodes.rationale: Single append-only place listing features with date, status, touched files and summary.

nodes.label: Feature Change Mirroring Rule
nodes.rationale: Every feature change must be mirrored into the brief, decision log and follow-up notes so context never drifts.

nodes.label: Vote Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Rate limiting enforced before vote processing continues, to prevent abuse.

nodes.label: Agent Handoff Payload
nodes.rationale: New agent handoff should carry goal, files touched, behavior rules, validation performed, open risks.

nodes.label: Agent Hand-off Standard
nodes.rationale: State task, touched files, risk, and next validation; point to .ai files instead of replaying chat.

nodes.label: Small-Fix Editing Rule
nodes.rationale: Prefer a small fix in the owning service or worker over a broad refactor.

nodes.label: Stronger Vote Event Durability
nodes.rationale: Consider if the Redis queue becomes a bottleneck.

nodes.label: Maven Parent POM Overrides
nodes.rationale: Empty overrides prevent inheriting unwanted <license> and <developers> from the parent POM.

nodes.label: AI Context Management Folder (.ai)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight memory layer so agents get stable context instead of long chat transcripts.

nodes.label: Environment-Based Secrets Decision
nodes.rationale: Secret values are not stable project knowledge and should move to environment-based configuration.

nodes.label: Redis-First Vote Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Redis is the first source for live vote acceptance and counting for low latency; PostgreSQL is the durable store.

nodes.label: Redis Vote Path and Queue Worker Test Matrix
nodes.norm_label: redis vote path and queue worker test matrix

nodes.label: Poll Expiration Handling
nodes.rationale: Polls auto-closed by scheduled worker and also validated at vote time.

nodes.label: Safe Recovery Checklist
nodes.rationale: Never purge vote:queue; fix the failing store then let the worker drain.

nodes.label: Async Vote Persistence
nodes.rationale: DB persistence is async so it never breaks the live vote count path.

nodes.label: Idempotent DB Inserts (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
nodes.norm_label: idempotent db inserts (on conflict do nothing)
nodes.rationale: Prevents duplicate rows when replaying the queue after failures.

nodes.label: Duplicate Vote Prevention
nodes.rationale: Duplicate votes must stay blocked per poll and user.

nodes.label: Atomic Lua Script for addVoter+increment
nodes.rationale: Avoids partial writes where voter is recorded but counter not incremented.
